Non-Cancer.decision: retain as broad filter label with specific companion labels
Non-Cancer.role: TCIA discovery grouping; not an assertion that every participant is healthy and not a single NCIt disease concept.
Non-Cancer.meaning: Dataset includes a documented non-cancer condition or healthy/non-cancer cohort component, including mixed cancer/non-cancer datasets.
Non-Cancer.companion_label_rule: Also apply the appropriate specific disease or documented cohort-context labels, verified against NCIt where a faithful concept exists. Reuse registered WordPress labels. Do not replace specific labels with Non-Cancer.
examples: Healthy Subject plus Non-Cancer when healthy cohort status is documented
Non-Cancer.matching_rule: The standalone Non-Cancer value must be present for the catch-all filter; parenthetical non-cancer in a specific label does not establish standalone membership.
limitations: Do not infer healthy subjects merely from absence of a cancer diagnosis.
Review synthetic phantom cases separately under the confirmed species/Not Applicable policy.
Dataset labels do not establish patient-level diagnoses or identify which participants belong to each subgroup.
Non-Cancer.wordpress_application: recommendations only; not applied by this agent

Gastroesophageal Cancer.decision: confirmed broad combined cohort meaning; ontology link unresolved
Gastroesophageal Cancer.meaning: Combined disease grouping covering stomach and esophageal cancers broadly; not restricted to the gastroesophageal junction.
Gastroesophageal Cancer.mapping_instruction: Find a faithful broad NCIt concept or use separate stomach and esophageal concept links. Do not substitute a gastroesophageal-junction-specific concept or assume a single histology.

Neuroendocrine Tumors (all sites).decision: confirmed broad umbrella meaning; ontology link unresolved
Neuroendocrine Tumors (all sites).meaning: Broad grouping covering neuroendocrine tumors and neuroendocrine carcinomas across anatomical sites.
Neuroendocrine Tumors (all sites).companion_label_rule: Add supported more specific disease labels where known, including Neuroendocrine Carcinoma when applicable.
Neuroendocrine Tumors (all sites).mapping_instruction: Verify an NCIt concept whose scope covers both neuroendocrine tumors and carcinomas. Do not select a concept restricted to well-differentiated tumors, a particular grade, or a particular anatomical site.
